thread:
DevOps Bot: [ALERT] MEDIUM - us-east generation endpoints returning 502s and elevated latency (incident id: INC-4799)

Jordan Lee: I'm paged. seeing error rate ~4% on /v1/generate across primary us-east pool since 09:42 UTC. Canary showed 502s start at 09:41. tagging @Hannah for triage.

Hannah Ortiz: joining. grabbing ingress and proxy logs, and checking autoscaler events. anyone see any deploys around that time?

Nora Patel: no deploys in that window. I see an unusual spike in health-check failures for one router pod and a config reload around 09:40. Could be bad config reload that temporarily dropped upstream connections.

Jordan Lee: ok, let's cordon the router and fail traffic to standby. Hannah, please roll back last config reload if it's reversible; otherwise restart the router pod.

Hannah Ortiz: rolling restart router-us-east-3 now.

DevOps Bot: [ACTION] Restart executed by Hannah Ortiz on router-us-east-3 at 09:49 UTC

Jordan Lee: after restart p95 dropped, 502s trending down to ~0.6%. keeping an eye for 30m. opening incident ticket INC-4799-PO for RCA.

Support Team: can we get list of customers who saw 5xxs between 09:40-09:50? prioritise paid tiers.

Hannah Ortiz: running query -> returned 9 tenant_ids with >10 errors each. top three: tenant-901 (Dedicated L), tenant-33a (Hosted Pro), tenant-7ff (Hosted Starter).

Finance Bot: detected subscriptions: tenant-901 has committed capacity contract, tenant-33a has hosted pro with 99.95% SLA, tenant-7ff free tier. Logging for billing review.

Jordan Lee: Nora, do we have request traces for tenant-33a to see whether errors were transient or full failures?

Nora Patel: tenant-33a had 42 errors; 28 were 502 immediate, 14 were retried and completed after failover. tenant-901 (dedicated) saw degraded throughput but no total request loss; requests queued causing elevated latency.

Jordan Lee: Support, please prepare a concise customer-facing message that avoids admitting fault or promising credits. For any dedicated customers, mention we will coordinate with account teams.

Support Team: draft below -- please review.

Support Team: "Hi <CustomerName>, we detected transient errors and elevated latency affecting generation in us-east between 09:40 and 09:50 UTC today. We applied mitigations and observed recovery by 09:49 UTC. We're investigating the root cause and will provide an incident report. If you experienced dropped requests, reply to this message and we will escalate for account/billing review."

Jordan Lee: good. Finance/Billing: create a worksheet with impacted tenants, plan, minutes affected, and preliminary credit eligibility. Tag it BILL-8820 and link here. Do not issue credits without legal/account approval.

Finance Bot: BILL-8820 created and assigned to Nora Patel. Columns: tenant_id, plan, commitment, affected_minutes, projected_credit_pct, notes.

Nora Patel: starting data capture. Quick initial calculation for hosted pro (tenant-33a): affected window ~10 minutes -> availability delta < threshold, projected 0% automated credit. Dedicated contract (tenant-901) requires account team review.

Legal Bot: note: dedicated contracts may have bespoke remedies under SOW; route to Account Mgmt and Legal for approval before any communications about credits.

Jordan Lee: acknowledged. Hannah, add a short mitigation timeline to INC-4799-PO listing exact config reload and restart times and the temporary fallback used.

Hannah Ortiz: added timeline and proxied config diff to the incident ticket. Also added a note to revert any temporary health-check thresholds we relaxed in the rollback.

Support Team: dispatching private DMs to tenant-901 and tenant-33a with the draft, but for tenant-901 we'll CC the account owner as requested.

Finance Bot: tenant-33a entry: affected_minutes=10, projected_credit_pct=0, note="below SLA threshold for hosted pro". tenant-901 entry: affected_minutes=10, projected_credit_pct=manual review.

Jordan Lee: final checks: Ops keep monitoring for 2 hours; Eng to root cause in postmortem; Support to hold on credit promises; Billing/Legal to coord on dedicated contract remedies.

Nora Patel: quick suggestion for customer note addendum: include instructions for customers to provide request_ids if they want deeper log exports; helps speed any manual review.

Support Team: adding that to the DM template.

DevOps Bot: [RECOVERY] Incident INC-4799 marked resolved by Jordan Lee at 10:30 UTC

Hannah Ortiz: thanks all. Action items recorded in ticket INC-4799-PO and BILL-8820. We'll loop back with a short RFC on avoiding config reload blips in future — maybe staged reload or circuit-breaker at proxy level.

Jordan Lee: closing out. Nora, please update BILL-8820 with final notes once legal routes decision for tenant-901.

Nora Patel: will update by EOD. Closing thread in 1 hour unless billing/legal flag outstanding. :white_check_mark:
